question: What will be the day of the week on 14 September 3041?
solution:

In 2800 Years the odd day is 0,

In 200 Years the odd day is 3,

In 40 Years (10 Leap Years and 30 Ordinary years) the odd day is 10 × 2 + 30 × 1 = 20 + 30 = 50 odd days,

⇒ 0 + 3 + 50

⇒ 53 odd days.

And, from 1st Jan 3041 to 14 September 3041:

⇒ 31(Jan) + 28(Feb, 3041 is not a leap year) + 31(March) + 30(April) + 31(May) + 30(June) + 31(July) + 31(August) + 14(September) = 257 days.

Total odd days → 53 + 257 = 310 days = 310/7 = 44 weeks and 2 odd days.
